RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the February 26, 2008/Phalguna 7, 1929 (Saka)

(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions  20
1
Development of Karipur Airport
(Kozhikode)
*1. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
complaints that the Karipur Airport,
Kozhikode, Kerala lacks even some basic
amenities;
(b) whether the Ministry is
implementing any projects to develop the
said airport; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Share of "Profit Petroleum" from
Barmer-Sanchar basin
*2. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) by when  commercial production of
oil and natural gas from Barmer-Sanchar
basin is expected;
(b) whether Central Government would
get "Profit Petroleum" from these fields;
(c) if so, by when;
(d) whether State Government will also
be given a share out of this profit;
(e) if so, how much percentage; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Taxes on ethanol
*3. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Andhra
Pradesh is one of the leading States in
production of ethanol in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that different
States are imposing different Sales Tax and
Value Added Tax on ethanol, which is
hampering the production of green-fuel in
the country;
(c) whether, due to differential tax rates,
the price of ethanol per litre in India is
more than what we are importing;
(d) if so, whether any proposal has been
submitted to Finance Ministry for
levying a uniform tax on ethanol; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

2
NABARD proposals for rural
development
*4. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Bank for
Agriculture and Rural Development
(NABARD) proposes to raise Rs. 4,000
crores for rural development;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what are the details of projects
located in Orissa that would be funded out
of this amount?
Per capita income of tribals and non-
tribals
*5.  MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the per capita income of
tribal and non-tribal population in
Jharkhand;
(b) what are the reasons for great
disparity among different communities; and
(c) in what manner Government
proposes to increase the income of tribals?
Air cargo clearance for China
*6. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether China has refused
Government's offer of Delhi as a port of
call to Chinese Cargo Carrier "Great Wall
Airlines" and has held up clearances for Air
India to fly to Guangzhou as was agreed  to
earlier, during the Chinese President's visit
to India last November;
(b) whether plans of Jet Airways to fly
to Chicago via  Shanghai too are blocked
up; and
(c) if so, what was China's demand in
return for concessions sought for Air India
cargo clearance and Government's response
thereto, and what is the dispute still
outstanding?
Irregularities in Sahitya Akademi
*7. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether eminent authors have
expressed grave concern about the alleged
falling standards and growing irregularities
in the Sahitya Akademi;
(b) if so, whether the provisions that
were framed to give representation to the
best and proven talents of all Indian
languages are being distorted and vested
interests are alleged to be making changes
with ulterior motives; and
(c) if so, whether Government would
institute an enquiry in their administrative,
financial and professional working?
Increase in airfare in Gulf sector
*8. PROF. P .J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has received
complaints alleging that Air India is hiking
the airfare in the Gulf route during the peak
seasons;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
stop this unjustified exploitation;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

3
Decline in irrigation by canals
*9. SHRIMATI SUSHMA SWARAJ:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been continuous decline in irrigation by
canals during the last ten years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of efforts being made to
enhance irrigation sector?
Volatility in stock markets
*10. SHRI DARA SINGH:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the stock markets in the
country witnessed the biggest single day
drop and rise this year resulting in single
day drop of 1408.35 points and investors
losing wealth of Rs. 6,63,975 crore in
January, 2008;
(b) if so, what are the reasons behind
the volatility in stock markets;
(c) whether any review has so far been
conducted to analyse the reasons for the
said steep fall and rise of markets;
(d) if so, the details thereof along with
steps taken, if any, to contain the extreme
swings; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Karnataka State Finance Corporation
*11. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has approached the Central
Government to direct Small Industries
Development Bank of India (SIDBI) to
resume refinance facility to Karnataka State
Finance Corporation so as to enable it to
help the Small and Medium Enterprises
financially;
(b) if so, the action taken thereon;
and
(c) if not, the reasons for delay and by
when necessary action in the matter is likely
to be taken?
Delay in flights due to fog
*12. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to heavy
fog, the flights from the Indira Gandhi
International  Airport (IGI), New Delhi,
had been long delayed;
(b) if so, the details of such delayed
flights during the last fortnight and financial
loss suffered as a result thereof;
(c) whether such fog spreads also in
airports of European countries and the fog
is cleared there in time to avoid delay;
(d) if so, whether Government has
approached such countries to provide such
technology to India to avoid delay and
loss;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the steps expected to be taken
to avoid delay in future?
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

4
Development of sites under Integrated
Development of Tourist Circuit
Scheme
*13. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Hoshiarpur
in Punjab has been identified to be
developed as tourist destination and
Central assistance of Rs. 4 crores has been
sanctioned towards that end in January,
2008;
(b) if so, whether Government would
also consider similar sites in tribal and
historically significant districts in Vidarbha
like Y avatmal, to be brought on the tourist
map under the Integrated Development of
Tourist Circuit Scheme;
(c) if so, what are the precise criteria
specified under this Scheme; and
(d) whether this Scheme is operated sou
motu by Government or periodic
consultations with State Governments are
also held?
Education loans from PSU Banks
*14. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount sanctioned by
Public Sector Banks as education loans to
students across the country;
(b) the number of applications which
have been received by each bank across
each State during the last financial year;
(c) the time taken to process the
applications to grant such loans by the
banks; and
(d) the steps being taken to improve
the performance of the banks for providing
better services to quickly release such loans
to the needy students across the country?
Accommodation for Tourists in
Buddhist places
*15. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is hardly
any infrastructure to accommodate a large
number of tourists from East Asia, China
etc. in Buddhist places;
(b) if so, what is being done to build the
same to facilitate the tourists; and
(c) what is the time-frame to do so?
Sexual assaults on foreign tourists
*16. SHRIMA TI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether attention of Government
has been drawn to the increasing incidents
of sexual assaults on foreign tourists;
(b) if so, what is Government's  reaction
thereto;
(c) whether it is a fact that a heavy
decrease in number of women foreign
tourists has been observed following such
incidents; and
(d) if so, the steps Government has
taken to address the problem?
Indirasager Project
*17. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of Andhra Pradesh
Government's proposal to the Central
Government to give early clearance to
Indirasagar (Polavaram) Project which is
aimed to provide irrigation facilities in
Visakhapatnam, East Godavari, West

5
Godavari, Krishna, Guntur and Prakasham
districts of Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the reasons for delay in sanctioning
it, especially when it will protect hundreds
of villages from inundation due to floods;
and
(c) by when it is likely to be given
clearance?
Manipulation of IPOs
*18. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Initial Public
Offerings (IPOs) are being over-priced in
collusion with merchant bankers, causing
losses to gullible small investors;
(b) whether IPO of Reliance Power Ltd.
(RPL) was rigged by promoters and
merchant bankers which was listed 17 per
cent below the issue price on 11th February,
2008;
(c) if so, whether Government would
probe the nexus between promoters,
merchant bankers and officers of Securities
and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
through the Central Bureau of Investigation
(CBI); and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Share margin requirement system
*19. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Securities
and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has
decided to review and re-look at share
margin requirement system;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the outcome of the review?
Anti-inflationary measures
*20. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the inflation
rate in the country hit a six month high of
4.11 per cent for the week ended January
26, 2008;
(b) if so, whether any measures are being
taken to contain inflation and make available
essential commodities, cereals, oil etc. at
reasonable prices to the common man;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 20th February, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 1, 1929 (Saka)
